source='''def transform(grid):
    """Expand by mirrored 3x2 copies of the input grid."""
    horizontal_flip = [row[::-1] for row in grid]
    vertical_flip = grid[::-1]
    rotate_180 = [row[::-1] for row in vertical_flip]

    def join(left, right):
        return [left_row + right_row for left_row, right_row in zip(left, right)]

    top = join(rotate_180, vertical_flip)
    middle = join(horizontal_flip, grid)
    return top + middle + top
